newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Police arrest suspect in East Timor violence.
newsitem.headline: Police arrest suspect in East Timor violence.

text.p: Police said on Thursday they had arrested one more person in connection with pre-Christmas violence in the East Timor capital of Dili in which an off-duty soldier was killed.

"We have arrested one more person and the number of arrested people is now 13. We will continue the investigation and could arrest more people," East Timor's deputy police chief, Colonel Atok Rismanto, told Reuters by telephone from Dili.

An angry crowd beat to death an off-duty army corporal in the grounds of Dili cathedral on December 24. Several other police and soldiers were attacked by sections of the crowd welcoming Nobel peace laureate Bishop Carlos Belo back to the territory.
Belo has publicly apologised for the death of the soldier, a native East Timorese and father of seven.
Rismanto said those detained were accused of mass destruction, assault and murder. He gave no other details but said Dili was quiet and calm on Thursday.
Indonesian troops invaded the former Portuguese colony in December 1975 and East Timor was incorporated as Indonesia's 27th province the following July in a move not recognised by the United Nations.
